title: How to Cancel YouTube Premium and Check Who Bills You (2026)
metaDescription: Cancel YouTube Premium through YouTube, Apple, or Google Play. Confirm the end date and use the correct refund channel for your payment.
intro: The important first step is finding the company that took the payment. A YouTube-billed membership can be cancelled on the paid memberships page. Apple and Google Play purchases stay under the app-store account that processed the charge.

steps.title: Open the paid memberships page
steps.text: Sign in to the Google account that pays for Premium and open youtube.com/paid_memberships. Check the membership details for the plan, renewal date, and billing provider.
steps.tip: If no paid membership appears, check another Google account and the receipt email before contacting support. The account watching videos may not be the account paying the bill.

steps.title: Cancel a membership billed by YouTube
steps.text: Choose Manage membership, then Deactivate. Select Continue to cancel, choose a reason, select Next, and finish with Yes, cancel.
steps.tip: A paid membership normally keeps its benefits until the end of the current billing period. The displayed end date is the date worth saving.

image.alt: YouTube Help page showing the numbered steps to cancel a paid membership
image.caption: YouTube's current computer instructions list Manage membership, Deactivate, Continue to cancel, a reason, and Yes, cancel.

steps.title: Use the app store when it handled the payment
steps.text: For an Apple-billed membership, manage the subscription in Apple Subscriptions. For a Google Play-billed membership, use the subscriptions area of the matching Google Play account.
steps.tip: The merchant name on the receipt tells you who can change the subscription and who decides a refund request.

image.alt: YouTube Help cancellation troubleshooting for Apple and Google Play billing
image.caption: YouTube's help page routes Apple- and Google Play-billed memberships back to the store that processed the payment.

steps.title: Keep the cancellation proof
steps.text: Check for the cancellation notification in YouTube and the confirmation email. Save the end date and make sure the membership page no longer shows a future renewal.
steps.tip: If the page still shows an active renewal, repeat the process in the billing account shown on the receipt.

warnings: Premium benefits continue until the end of a normal paid billing period, then ad-free viewing, background play, and offline downloads end.
Apple handles cancellation and refund requests for memberships purchased through Apple billing.
Only the family manager can cancel a YouTube Premium family membership.
YouTube says annual memberships are prepaid and do not receive a partial refund after cancellation.

faqs.q: Will my playlists and channel disappear after I cancel?
faqs.a: Cancelling Premium ends the paid benefits. It does not delete the Google account, channel, subscriptions, or playlists attached to that account.
For a normal paid cancellation, Premium remains active through the date shown on the membership page. The free YouTube experience resumes after that date.

faqs.q: Can I get a YouTube Premium refund?
faqs.a: Refund handling depends on the billing provider and the reason for the request. YouTube directs Apple purchases to Apple. For a YouTube-billed active membership, sign in on YouTube's refund page to see the available request route. Approval follows the provider's refund policy.

faqs.q: Why can I not find the membership I am being charged for?
faqs.a: The usual cause is a different Google or Apple account. Match the receipt email, merchant name, and account address before opening a support case.

refund.details: A refund may be available for a billing problem or when the paid service did not work as expected, subject to YouTube's policy. Apple decides refunds for Apple-billed purchases. Annual memberships do not receive a partial refund simply because they were cancelled early.

policyImages.alt: YouTube Help page showing refund troubleshooting and billing-provider routes
policyImages.caption: YouTube's refund troubleshooting page separates YouTube-handled requests from Apple-billed purchases and other payment problems.

retentionTactics: The cancellation flow may offer a pause before the final cancel option.
The confirmation screens list the Premium features that will end.
sourceNote: We checked YouTube's current cancellation, troubleshooting, and refund pages on August 25, 2026. Button labels can differ by device and billing provider.
